original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can scripts/experiments/mixed_point_circuit.py:Circuit.verify replace its exact-|source∩target|=r expected-support genexpr with an equivalent closed-form point-incidence mask (OR over r-subsets U of the target of inputs that contain every point of U and avoid every other target point) so verify still returns True, every output support matches the historical checker, and support require() rejection is preserved on mixed-point and early-sharing replay sizes?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after mixed-point scalar_check digests (#1984), SharedPoint digests (#1994), ExclusionCircuit/DisjointTensor support masks (#2001), and open leave-alone construction PRs (#2039/#2054). Profiling named Circuit.verify's set-intersection genexpr (tens of seconds on h≈40) as the next unclaimed mixed-point hot path; DisjointTensor.dag_sha256 hand-roll was measured at only ~1.22× on full verify and deferred.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: tests/test_mixed_point.py and any caller of Circuit.verify pay the historical genexpr. A faster identical support check does not change kappa, scalar_check digests, or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving Circuit.verify support-mask change with frozen baseline, identical True receipts plus matching output supports on historical sizes through h=30, updated source pins only on the two binding certificates, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not touch audit_mixed_point.scalar_check, SharedPoint, DisjointTensor.frame_data, or run the selected cold frontier replay.
evidence: PASS_MIXED_POINT_VERIFY_MASKS via research/mixed-point-verify-masks/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_MIXED_POINT_VERIFY_MASK_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; two certificates differ from base only in the scripts/experiments/mixed_point_circuit.py source pin.
author: Wentao Li
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, implementation, packaging, benchmarking and writing. Not independent human peer review.
